detail.description:
The hugely popular flower-planting game loved by players worldwide is officially launching in Thailand on June 3rd!
Enjoy ongoing in-game events with a chance to win real flowers, delivered directly to your home for players in Thailand!

My Flower Garden is a relaxing and therapeutic simulation game where you'll meet many flower-loving friends and build your own flower-lover community.
